stage1.impression: A competent, warm night render of a long timber-and-concrete bar. The centrepiece reads as a hanging neon gyroscope of thin RGB hoops, not as thick cast acrylic, and it pulls the room toward a nightclub. The pale, glossy foreground floor and the flat, bright right-hand wall give it away as CG, and the identical stools and Orb tables repeat in a catalogue rhythm. As it stands, a magazine would see a generic, well-lit bar with one loud light sculpture, not a specific place. The altar pair at the far end is too small and glary to work as the altar.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must read as six thick, slotted discs of tinted cast acrylic with glowing polished rims. Now it reads as thin LED hoops: disc faces at lum_median 24.8 in [600,0,890,290], almost invisible.
The foreground floor must not be the brightest large surface in the frame. It is now lum_median 66.5 in [150,550,700,800] against 38.3 for the whole frame.
The right-hand board-formed concrete must show formwork grain, tie holes and pour lines at 1:1, at a lower, warmer value. It is now uniform speckle at lum_median 77 in [860,120,1060,450].
The altar pair must read as smoked horn speakers on an altar. Now they read as small white PA boxes with blown batts (p95 233 in [515,330,560,435]).
Set dressing must break the repetition and show life: 7 identical stools, 4 identical Orb tables all square to camera, and props too dark to read.
The globe needs headroom at the top: its upper rim is about 5 px from the frame edge.

defects.what: Globe discs read as thin neon rings/hoops of uniform emissive colour. Disc bodies are nearly invisible, with no visible 25 mm thickness or slot detail. It reads as nightclub signage.
The globe's top rim nearly touches the frame edge.
The coloured shadow on the wall is pale and washed out (lum_median 119, low saturation). It reads as a projected stained-glass slide more than a hard-spot shadow through tinted acrylic.
The concrete wall is flat and speckled with no board-form grain. The two large frames/screens read as blank grey canvases.
The floor is pale, cool and polished, with large smeary reflections and blotchy denoiser texture. It is the brightest big surface and draws the eye down and out of the room.
Altar speakers: white batts blown (p95 233/211), small in frame, and they read as white monitor boxes. The cone of light above each speaker shows as a grey wedge.
The zinc counter top is very bright (lum_median 135, p95 235) and slightly plasticky.
Seven identical bar stools, evenly spaced and identically rotated, with identical leather backs. A repeated-model tell.
Four identical Orb tables with identical lamp placement, evenly stepped down the aisle.
Fir ceiling has a strong orange cast (r86 g42 b20) and smooth, uniform grain, with no checks or nail holes.
Visible fine noise/grain on the concrete at 1:1.
The back zone is muddy and low-contrast behind the glass. The altar does not read as a destination.

changes.problem: Mother EARF reads as neon hoops: the rims are saturated emitters while the disc faces carry no light, so the acrylic's thickness and tint disappear.

evidence.measured: lum_median 24.8, p5 9.3, p95 115.8. Rim pixels are bright saturated colour, and the disc faces are as dark as the ceiling behind them.

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow and hard spot
change.from: rim glow 0.025, hard spot 135.0 W cone 20 deg
change.to: rim glow 0.012, hard spot 220 W cone 24 deg, plus a soft 2700 K grazing fill (about 15 W area) from below-left so the disc faces and slots catch a sheen

changes.expected: The disc faces read as tinted, transparent slabs with edge glow from transmitted light rather than LED strips, the globe's median lifts to about 35-45, and the coloured shadow saturates.

changes.problem: The foreground floor is pale, glossy and smeared. It is the brightest large area in the frame and reads as CG.

evidence.measured: lum_median 66.5 vs frame 38.3, p95 185.7. Blotchy reflections and denoiser smear at 1:1.

change.to: darker warm grey (about 40% darker albedo), roughness raised to about 0.45 with a subtle roughness variation map so reflections break up

changes.expected: The floor drops below the bar and the tables and lets the pools of light from the Orbs and Domes read as pools. The eye goes to the globe and the altar.

changes.problem: The right-hand concrete is flat, bright, speckled plaster rather than board-formed concrete.

evidence.measured: lum_median 77.2, lum_range 122.7. No formwork grain, tie holes or pour lines visible at 3x crop.

change.to: about 30% darker warm grey with a visible board-form bump/albedo (100-150 mm boards), tie holes on a 600 mm grid, faint pour lines and staining, low sheen

changes.expected: The wall reads as Ando-style concrete under warm light, and the globe's coloured shadow gains contrast against it.

changes.problem: The altar spots blow out the speakers' white batts and leave the smoked cabinets dark, so the pair reads as white monitor boxes.

evidence.measured: p95 233, clip 0.04%, median 33. The right speaker is at p95 211.5.

change.to: 110 W, cone 22 deg aimed at the horn mouth, plus a low 2700 K rim/back light behind each cabinet so the smoked acrylic edges glow

changes.expected: The batts no longer clip, the cabinet silhouettes and horns separate from the fir wall, and the altar reads as a destination.

changes.problem: Seven identical stools and four identical Orb tables in even rows read as a repeated model and a showroom.

evidence.measured: Visual: identical rotation, spacing and backs on every stool. Identical lamp position on every table.

change.from: all stools square and evenly spaced. Tables bare except for the Orbs.
change.to: rotate the stools by -15 to +20 deg at random and pull two out. Put the coat over the nearest stool. Put a rocks glass and a napkin on the near Orb table, a coupe on the second, and a record sleeve on the banquette.

changes.expected: The room reads as lived in, with signs of a guest who just left. The repetition tell goes.

changes.problem: The globe's top rim nearly touches the frame edge, which crowds the centrepiece.

evidence.measured: The ring's top is about 5 px from the edge.

change.to: 1.50 m (or a vertical lens shift of about +4%)

changes.expected: The globe sits with about 30-40 px of headroom, and verticals stay true.

changes.problem: The fir ceiling and bar carry a strong orange cast that competes with the globe's colours and breaks the one-colour rule.

change.to: 2750 (neutralise toward the 2400-2700 K sources), and AgX look to Medium Contrast

changes.expected: The timber stays warm brown rather than orange, and the globe's tints become the only saturated colour.

changes.problem: The air is too clean for a night bar, and the hard spot's beam and the pools of light lack atmosphere.

evidence.measured: No visible beam between the spot and the wall. Haze is 0.003 per metre.

changes.expected: A faint visible cone from the globe's spot and a soft glow around the Domes, without lifting the shadows above the target median.

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs visibly thicker, with more pronounced slots, so they cannot read as hoops.
out_of_scope.why: The globe's shape and parts are EARF's product and fixed. Only its light can change.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the six saturated tints, which pull the room toward a nightclub/rainbow sign.
out_of_scope.why: The owner chose these colours. They are fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Swap the identical stool model for a mix of pedigree seats.
out_of_scope.why: The seats are part of the room's fixed design.

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar speakers larger or more prominent in the frame.
out_of_scope.why: Product size and the altar layout are fixed. Only the camera could change this, and that would cost the from-the-door brief.
